name: Hojo-ASR V1
blurb: A Chinese-English conversational ASR leader — Qwen3 decoding, code-switching, dialect support, and Apache 2.0 weights.
about: Hojo-ASR V1 is a conversational speech-recognition model built around an encoder-adapter-LLM stack with a Qwen3 decoder and a custom multi-frame acoustic-fusion front end. Its current independent Open ASR Leaderboard result is 4.46% average cleaned WER, placing it among the strongest openly downloadable systems on the English short-form benchmark.

The model targets real-world Mandarin and English speech, including Chinese-English code-switching, noisy audio, informal pronunciation, oral corrections, Cantonese, and Sichuan dialect. HojoAI distributes the weights under Apache 2.0 and provides a `hojo-asr` Python package for inference, making it commercially usable while remaining focused on a narrower language set than broad multilingual families such as Qwen3-ASR.
install:
pip install -U hojo-asr huggingface_hub

hf download HojoAI/Hojo-ASR-V1 --local-dir hojo-asr-v1
# See the model card for HOJO_ASR.load_model() inference usage.
